title: Packing and Covering for Infinite Matroids
exact_target: Let $M$ and $N$ be matroids on a common ground set $E$. Does there exist a partition $E=P\mathbin{\dot\cup}C$ such that the restrictions $M|P$ and $N|P$ have disjoint spanning sets, while the contractions $M.C$ and $N.C$ have independent sets whose union is $C$?
